props.title: How a booking works
props.description: Every step between the first email and the last invoice for a live band booking: reply times, what arrives with the contract, when the run of show gets locked, and what we need from you at each point.

props.title: From the first email to the last invoice.
props.lede: Here's what happens at each step, who does it, and how long it takes. The contract, the certificate of insurance and the W-9 arrive in one email.

props.html: Timings assume a date six months out. A booking made three weeks before the event goes through the same steps in the same order, only faster. For a wedding, what couples report about their own timing is set out in how far ahead to book wedding musicians in Colorado.

props.html: Three things we need from you
Six of those nine steps need nothing from you at all. Three do, and they're the three that stall a booking when they arrive late.

rows.term: The date and the venue, to get a number
rows.text: A city works if the venue isn't chosen yet. We can price a night without a signed venue and re-price it when you have one, because travel is its own line on the quote.

rows.term: The venue name, to raise the certificate of insurance
rows.text: The certificate names your venue as additional insured, so it can't be issued before the venue is chosen.

rows.term: The run of show, whenever it exists
rows.text: Send us the draft, even if it's nowhere near final. We'll fill in the band's rows against whatever you have and send it back, whether or not you've booked us.

props.html: Guest counts move, programs get rewritten, a venue falls through. Tell us and we'll re-quote. Added performance time costs what the earlier hours did, a smaller build re-prices down, and a changed date is something we'll talk through with you.
If a musician can't make the date, you get the substitute's name and the reason as soon as we have them.

props.title: Send us the date and the venue.
props.lede: That's enough for us to come back with an exact number.

props.html: Also for planners: what we need from your venue, the run of show templates and the full question list.
